decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program uses core clinical expertise, is reimbursed by health insurers and has its own page, so continuation is very likely.
The carpentry workshop provides meaningful sheltered employment and draws on the firm's production know-how, so it remains an integral offer even though the retail shop was closed.
Outpatient sociotherapy complements the psychiatric outpatient portfolio and is reimbursable, though its smaller web presence leaves some risk of consolidation.
Senior living counseling is cheap to run, close to core eldercare, channels clients into the firm's facilities and is featured prominently.
Meal delivery for seniors is a newly launched, demand-driven support service that fits outpatient eldercare, though its thin margins and modest web presence carry some risk.
